output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initialSupply is added to the target's balance without a check, allowing the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value.

The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balanceOf[_to] += _value; statement can overflow if _value is of a large enough value, causing it to wrap around and become disproportionately smaller, allowing the owner to steal funds.

The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balanceOf[_to] += _value; statement can overflow if _value is of a large enough value, causing it to wrap around and become disproportionately smaller, allowing the owner to steal funds.
The buy function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The amount variable is set to msg.value * buyRate; If buyRate is sufficiently large, overflow can occur, allowing the owner to steal funds.
The withdrawToOwner function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The amountWei is transferred to the owner, allowing the owner to steal funds if the balance is large.
